items.text: Ismail Baghaei, the spokesperson of the Ministry of Foreign Affairs, faced negative reactions during the play "Arash." Some reformist-affiliated figures criticized the audience's reaction. In a recent press conference, a journalist asked Baghaei about this issue.

The police chief of Rey County announced the arrest of a man accused of killing his son-in-law. The suspect confessed to the murder with a hammer. He claimed his motive was the victim's harassment of his daughter.

The family of Nazanin Esmikani distributed food among the poor in her memory and that of other martyrs of the national revolution. Nazanin Esmikani, a 17-year-old student, was killed on January 8, 2026, in Qazvin. This video was released by Iran International.

Britain has stated that the Farford operation was definitely directed by the IRGC. The country has issued an unprecedented warning to Tehran. This was mentioned in the audio version of Titrawol with Niusha Saremi.

Netanyahu is trying through US mediation to gain Saudi Arabia's approval for Israel's participation in a military operation against the Houthis in Yemen. The Saudi crown prince opposes this participation due to concerns about negative public reaction. Netanyahu is also seeking to strengthen relations with Riyadh and pave the way for normalization agreements.

The spokesperson for the Saudi-led coalition forces announced that the country's air defense successfully intercepted and destroyed incoming missiles from Yemen. On Monday night, several explosions occurred in Riyadh, likely due to the interceptor missiles' operation. The Saudi Civil Defense informed citizens about 10 minutes after the alert that the threat was eliminated.

At least six protest gatherings were held today, Monday, 20 Mehr. Retired telecommunications workers in Ahvaz, Kermanshah, Sanandaj, Isfahan, Khorramabad, and laid-off workers at Khavar spinning factory in Rasht protested. Their demands included unpaid wages and benefits, healthcare services, and job status clarification.

The interrogation session of 12 citizens related to the Qaleh Chenan case was held at the second interrogation branch of Karun County. Charges include moharebeh, baghi, and disruption of public order. The accused are deprived of access to lawyers and meetings with their families.

The Leadership Council of Yemen's Presidency declared that spying, financing, or aiding the Houthis is a crime punishable by death. The council has instructed security agencies to immediately take legal action and refer cases to the judiciary. Citizens are also urged to report related crimes, with protections in place for informants.

Ali Amirian, silver medalist in the 800 meters at the Nagoya Asian Games, spoke about the difficulties in his early sports career. He mentioned challenges such as lack of a coach, coach changes, and injuries, emphasizing that medals are the result of joint efforts between athletes and coaches. Amirian also called for more support for athletics and expressed his goal to participate in the Olympics.

The head of the Supreme Council of the Cultural Revolution announced a 5% quota for war-affected university entrance exam candidates. This quota applies to candidates whose homes were destroyed in the 12-day and 40-day wars and require major reconstruction. The resolution was approved on July 13, 2026, and has been announced for implementation.

Amnesty International stated that the Islamic Republic uses executions as a tool to intimidate people. The organization referred to the execution of five protesters in December 1404 (Iranian calendar). The executions took place between October 8 and 13 in various cities in Iran.

The death sentences of four prisoners convicted of murder and drug-related crimes were carried out in Tabriz prison. These executions took place on Wednesday, October 8. The prisoners were sentenced in separate cases.

An investigative report was published about the matchmaking platform 'Adam and Eve' showing profiles of 13 and 14-year-old girls as marriage options. The platform operates with official government permission and is linked to a group associated with a former member of the Revolutionary Guards. Ayah Dris discussed this issue and the role of Islamic Republic laws in expanding child marriage in Iran on the program 'Pivast'.

Masoud Kanaani criticized industries for neglecting the employment of local forces in Khuzestan. He said the lack of job opportunities has caused some families to depend on the Relief Committee and Welfare Organization. Economic problems have also led some students to drop out of school.

The 41st birthday ceremony of Aref Barati was held at his grave with the presence of family and close ones. His sister said that his ideals did not extinguish and he became a beacon of freedom. Aref Barati was killed by security forces on January 8, 2026, during protests in Kuhchenar, Fars province.

The chain stores system of Intermarché in France was targeted by a cyberattack. The cooling equipment temperature rose to 80 degrees Celsius, ruining fresh and frozen products. The store manager announced that these products must be discarded.

Mojtaba Haghlasan has been appointed as the commander of Unit 840 of the Quds Force. The unit's name has been changed to 600. This unit is responsible for covert sabotage and assassination operations against opponents of the Islamic Republic worldwide.

A citizen in Najafabad, Isfahan released white balloons with the slogan "The end of the dark night is white." The video was published by Iran International. This act took place near the Azad University area.

The Saudi Council of Ministers announced that the Houthis supported by the Islamic Republic will face consequences for their repeated attacks on airports, Mecca, and Medina. These attacks have harmed pilgrims to holy sites and civilian and economic facilities. The Council also expressed condolences to the families of the victims and wished recovery for the injured.

The Deputy of Primary Education of the Ministry of Education announced the identification of about 140,000 children out of school in the 1404–1405 academic year. Of these, 48,000 children have been enrolled in schools.

Today, victims of the Etimad Iranian Credit Cooperative and Fajr Bahman Company gathered in front of Mashhad court. They demanded resolution of financial cases and the return of their assets. The protesters also called for speeding up the case review process.

A citizen reported severe drug price increases in Iran in a video to Iran International. He said that to survive, one must not get sick because they cannot afford medicine. This issue has raised concerns about access to medication.

Parviz Sarvari, deputy chairman of Tehran City Council, criticized Mohammad Javad Zarif and Hossein Marashi's stance on tactical retreat during the council meeting. He stated that retreat at this historical juncture means signing the document of Iran's destruction. Sarvari emphasized maintaining power and deterrence as key factors for the country's survival.

The Israeli Prime Minister stated during a visit to the West Bank border that the Israeli army is prepared for any scenario. He emphasized that the Israeli army will maintain control of the area and no Arab army will be stationed west of the Jordan River. Netanyahu also said that from the Jordan River to the sea, the land belongs to Israel and its control will remain with them.

Donald Trump stated that the Houthis, after a period of silence, have likely resumed their activities under Iran's orders and are attacking Saudi Arabia. He said the Houthis are trying to raise oil prices before the US elections. Trump also described Iran as a declining country with the worst economy in the world.

New research shows that reducing consumption of ultra-processed foods along with regular exercise reduces the risk of type 2 diabetes by up to 50 percent. This change also improves brain and mental health. Nutrition experts recommend gradually replacing packaged snacks with natural foods.

Milad Balsini, a Turk activist, has been detained for 57 days after being summoned to Branch 15 of the Tabriz Public and Revolutionary Prosecutor's Office. There is still no information about his place of detention or the status of his case. This has been confirmed by a source close to Balsini's family.

Mohammad Moheydi Azad, the Attorney General, announced that all judicial units have been instructed to monitor lawyers' adherence to hijab. In case of violation, disciplinary action and disqualification of lawyers will be pursued. Lawyers are also required to warn individuals who violate the rules.

Donald Trump stated that Washington will decide about the Islamic Republic very soon. The Wall Street Journal reported that Tehran is strengthening its defense capabilities and threatening a broader response against the US and its allies. Attacks on ships in the Strait of Hormuz have reached the highest level since the start of the war.

Benjamin Netanyahu proposed to Donald Trump last week to start a large-scale military operation against Iran. Netanyahu cited Iran's new nuclear activities as the reason for this proposal. The Israeli army and CENTCOM are on high alert.

Alireza Namvar Haghighi says the Islamic Republic is escalating tensions to reduce the chance of surprise and increase costs for the US and regional countries. Tehran aims to reach a better position for an agreement or force the US to retreat. This calculation could lead to attacks on infrastructure and increased domestic dissatisfaction.

At least four protest gatherings were held, including one in Mashhad by victims of the Iranian Trust Credit Cooperative and Fajr Bahman Company. Protests by retired telecommunications workers were also reported in Bijar, Hamedan, and Tehran. These gatherings focused on financial, welfare, and insurance demands.

Israel's Defense Minister Yisrael Katz warned of attempts by enemies, primarily the Islamic Republic, to carry out terrorist attacks before the elections. He emphasized that the army and security forces are ready to defend the country. He also warned that any attack on Israel will be met with a severe response.

Iran's Foreign Ministry summoned the British ambassador over allegations of Iran's involvement in the incident at the Fairford airbase. The director-general of Western Europe at the Foreign Ministry denied the accusation and requested evidence. The number of countries signing a joint statement on Iran's role in the incident has increased to 34.

A citizen sent a video showing severe decline and emptiness in Tehran's fruit and vegetable market on Monday, October 12. The video was sent to Iran International. The market's condition on this day indicates reduced activity.

Workers at the Float Glass Factory in Takestan reported unpaid wages for three months and unpaid insurance premiums for eight months. Unemployment insurance recipients in Tehran have also protested the non-payment of their October benefits. These issues were reported on the 21st of the current month.

Mehdi Mahdavi-Azad described the joint statement of 30 countries against Iran's extraterritorial actions as a political warning. The statement emphasizes that any hostile action by Iran on their soil will face a strong response. Recent cases in the UK also highlight Western concerns about Iran's extraterritorial activities.
Tehran has warned the region about ground attacks. Trump announced an imminent decision. These news were published in the audio version of Titrawal with Niusha Saremi.

Two prisoners accused of murder were executed on October 11 in Gorgan prison. Additionally, a death row convict in Chaldoran was released after unconditional forgiveness by the victim's family. These reports were published by Harana News Agency.

Mohammad Reza Naqdi stated that American commanders have not even considered a preliminary ground attack on Iran because they lack the capability. He added that if the US launches a ground attack, it will suffer heavy losses and be forced to surrender. Naqdi also said that the American fleet has been wandering for seven months and has fled from starting a war.

The Vortexa group reported that the US blockade reduced Iran's maritime crude oil exports to zero in October. Iran's oil exports were about 230,000 barrels per day at the beginning of September, dropping to zero in the second week and remaining unchanged until October 5. Additionally, Iran's liquefied gas exports decreased by 48 percent.
